args.title: Cold-Chain 2026: Article + Companion Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" (blog.bellwether.example) and its subscriber companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion):

- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- The subscriber companion reports that these pilots cut claims by a quarter.
